headline: Xiaomi's grip loosens as DeepSeek consolidates the top two
summary: Xiaomi mimo-v2.5 held rank 1 but shed 4.1% token share in a single day—its steepest drop yet—while DeepSeek's two models (v4-flash at 2, v4-pro climbing to 5) now command 19.8% combined. InclusionAI's ling-3.0-flash hit an all-time high of 2.6%, Anthropic's claude-opus-5 extended its record streak to day 2, and Perplexity's pplx-embed-v1-0.6B cracked the top 21 with a fresh all-time peak of 1.0%.
highlights: Xiaomi mimo-v2.5 drops 4.1% share in one day despite holding #1; DeepSeek now 19.8% of market
InclusionAI ling-3.0-flash debuts at rank 10 with all-time high 2.6% share
Anthropic claude-opus-5 extends all-time record to day 2 at 1.7% share
Perplexity pplx-embed-v1-0.6B hits all-time high 1.0%, jumps 8 ranks to #21
Qwen qwen3.7-plus and OpenAI gpt-5-mini enter top 50; two Qwen and Google models exit
